Honeydew melon adds a watery freshness whilst davana oil gives a sensual quality. Tonka bean brings an almond-meets-tobacco edge that’s warm and intensely masculine. The bottle is inspired by the masculine functionality of an antique hip flask. It is dark and sleek, combining black translucent lacquer with masculine gunmetal. The cap features distinctive Jimmy Choo detailing with embossed crocodile leather to add a touch of luxury and a nod to rock and roll rebellion.. Fragrance notes. Top notes - Lavender, Honeydew Melon Heart notes - Davana, Geranium, Pepper Base notes - Patchouli, Cistus Labdanum, Tonka Bean.

listings.rawTitle: JIMMY CHOO I WANT CHOO EAU DE PARFUM 40 ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo has created a new feminine fragrance with the arrival of ‘I Want Choo’, an ode to the playful spirit and confident glamour that epitomises the Jimmy Choo woman.. . ‘I Want Choo’ is a powerful oriental floral fragrance that explodes with joy finished with a seductive twist.. . Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau de Parfum is a powerful oriental floral fragrance that explodes with joy and finishes with a seductive twist. Excitement and anticipation: a sparkling, citrus top note of Mandarin juice contrasts with velvety Peach nuances. Let the party begin: the sensual and solar Vanilla-like notes of Red Spider Lily blend with Jasmine Sambac to reveal a determined and daring allure. Dancing the night away: the base notes of Vanilla and Benzoin, a duo of rich intense scents, anchor the fragrance in a deep, yet joyful way, leaving an intense trail behind.. The I Want Choo campaign emphasizes the energy and intensity of the new, sensual fragrance as three friends get ready to party the night away. It is not about going out, it is all about sharing the fun, the laughter and making it a girl’s night in to remember.. The bottle is a true object of desire. Featuring a bold gold spray cap with a hammered jeweled effect and the precious JC monogram logo, all underlined by the soft and ulra-feminine peach tint of the fragrance.. TOP NOTES: Mandarin Juice, Velvet Peach. . MIDDLE NOTES: Red Spider Lily, Jasmin Sambac. BASE NOTES: Vanilla, Benzoin, Resinoid. .

listings.description: Born to voice the Maison’s values of diversity and individuality, VOCE VIVA fragrance comes alive in a dialogue between Lady Gaga and Pierpaolo Piccioli. The sleek glass bottle inspired by a couture silhouette is topped with a cap enriched by iconic Rock stud details. Illuminating its distinctive character, a V of light shines through the golden-hued scent.. . listings.rawTitle: YSL LIBRE INTENSE EDP 90 ml
listings.description: Libre: the new Intense Eau de Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent. The perfume of an intense woman living her roaring freedom and following her instincts. . The iconic structure of Libre, a tension between French lavender and Moroccan orange blossom, reinterpreted in a suave and sensual way. The intensity of a melting floral core, where orange blossom flower absolute and blazing orchid accord fuse.. The iconic Libre it-bottle reflects a tension between masculinity and femininity, like a straight geometric silhouette embedded in the smoking jacket. The couture extravagance of the oversized Cassandre bent & nailed into the glass, breaking all the codes.. Libre Intense encapsulates a new fragrance shade, between fire and gold. An audaciously masculine signature twisted in its most feminine way by the desirability of the emblematic Libre bottle. listings.rawTitle: DOLCE & GABBANA K EDP 150 ml
listings.description: #OWNYOURCROWN Built on the legacy of K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Toilette, K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum is a sensual new scent that embodies the spirit of a man who chooses his destiny with passion and confidence. Inspired by the earthy, rugged landscape of Tuscany, the original fragrance is reinterpreted to evoke the intense and magnetic sides of this king of everyday life.. Maintaining the chiseled, geometric form of the original K by Dolce&Gabbana flacon, the bottle is now dressed in a deeper hue of regal blue, reflecting the new intensity of the magnetic fragrance within. The iconic crown is now overlaid with a burnished silver patina, accentuating the noble blue of its lapis dome. On the bottle itself, the crowned letter K conjures the traditional symbol of royalty, but with a bold simplicity that is contemporary in character.. Top Notes: As well as the Eau de Toilette, K by Dolce & Gabbana Eau de Parfum opens with an invigorating fusion of zesty citruses, sparkling blood orange mingling with lemon torchio essence to create an effervescent opening accord. Sharpened by the fresh tang of juniper berry, these citruses are enlivened by a new spicy note of cardamom.. . . Heart Notes: A spark of pimento essence ignites the heart of the fragrance and magnifies its passionate intensity. Crisp geranium blended with calming clary sage and energizing lavandin are given a new sensuality by the addition of a fig milk accord, which lends a smooth creamy touch that melds with the lingering warmth of spices.. . . Base Notes: The fragrance then unfurls to a seductive base of sensual cedarwood, smouldering patchouli and earthy vetiver, strengthened and amplified by a vibrant new note of smoky nagarmotha wood.. . .

listings.rawTitle: DOLCE & GABBANA POUR FEMME INTENSE EDP 100 ml
listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana Intense is a strong alchemy of refined and powerfully addictive contrasts. First came Pour Femme: the classic perfume that embodied in scent the harmonies and contrasts at the heart of the Dolce & Gabbana DNA. The traditional and the contemporary, the passionate and the maternal, the spiritual and the sensual: this is a world where all converge with a perfect synthesis that is unmistakably Dolce & Gabbana. Now, Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana showcase these values in their most potent form, with new Dolce & Gabbana Intense. “Deep within the soul of the Dolce & Gabbana woman lies a potent force: a power and passion that is voluptuous in its intensity. The moments when this force is ignited, are the moments for Intense.” say Domenico Dolce & Stefano Gabbana.. Intense’s luxurious packaging juxtaposes sensual opulence with intimate spirituality. The richly coloured, almost opaque burgundy glass — a favourite hue of the atelier — heightens the mood of drama. Statuesque with elegant shoulders that form precise angles, the bottle’s striking silhouette features a solid gold collar and burgundy cap.. Top Notes: The heightened potency of this oriental floral ignites the senses with subtle hints of Neroli and Green Mandarin initially.. . . Heart Notes: The top notes yield to the rich opulence and intriguing contrast of two noble white flowers, Orange Blossom and Tuberose, giving an intense full-bodied feminine signature to the perfume, that turns-heads and intrigues.. . . Base Notes: The warm resinous Sandalwood and the sensual musky notes that blend irresistibly with the creamy addiction of the Guimauve, define a powerful presence of captivating sensuality.. . .

listings.rawTitle: ARMANI MY WAY INTENSE EDP For Her 90 ml
listings.description: Discover My Way Intense, Giorgio Armani's new feminine fragrance. An amplified bright floral bouquet on an addictive woody trail, encapsulating intense experiences and authentic encounters around the world. Live your way, intensely.. My Way intense is an invitation to a journey of self-discovery, meaningful encounters and amplified experiences. An amplified florality on an addictive woody trail, made of consciously sourced ingredients. The scent opens with bright notes of orange blossom from Egypt. A new intense heart of tuberose from India unveils a creamy and velvety facet of the floral signature. At the base of the fragrance, the sandalwood from New Caledonia takes an addictive creamy turn, as it meets a voluptuous Vanilla from Madagascar.. The blue and gold jewel-like cap of My Way Intense bottle symbolizes a powerful talisman that captures all the experiences. Both the intensity and significance of these moments captured in the cap have infused the My Way Intense bottle, as its glass is now bathed in translucent blue reflections. The deep blue of the cap, metaphor of the Earth, is accented with a golden ring that lends a luxurious, gilded touch. The bold glass bottle displays MY WAY INTENSE’s new, striking pink juice.. Fragrance Notes. Top Notes: Orange Blossom. Heart Notes: Tuberose. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: LANCOME LA NUIT TRÉSOR EDP 100 ml
listings.description: Discover La Nuit Trésor, a sultry, smouldering perfume for women with notes of fresh raspberry, frankincense, and vanilla, with a bewitching heart of Black Rose essence. This new fragrance is Lancôme’s first ‘Gourmand Woody Floriental’ perfume, a scent of passionate love - as showcased in the new advert featuring the beautiful Penelope Cruz. This rich and exquisite women’s perfume was crafted by two master perfumers who combined their craftsmanship to create La Nuit Trésor Eau de Parfum. Beginning with a burst of delicious raspberry, the notes of a Damascena rose have then been enhanced to give the fragrance a deep and mysterious scent. Vanilla, grown on the petals of an orchid in Tahiti, gives the fragrance a solar and radiant note.. The La Nuit Trésor bottle is shaped like a black diamond, the most mysterious and precious of all diamonds, and adorned with a black rose choker as a symbol of elegance.. Fragrance Notes. Top Notes: Raspberry, Lychee, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Frankincense, Rose. Base Notes: Vanilla Tahitensis, Patchouli, Papyrus.

listings.rawTitle: ISSEY MIYAKE FUSION D'ISSEY EAU DE TOILETTE 100 ml
listings.description: Bold and contrasting: an eruption of energy and vitality. . Awake your senses with Fusion d'Issey Eau de Toilette, made of solar and mineral notes inspired by the contrast of natural elements: water and fire, hot and cold. Powerful, vigorous and fiery, nature reveals itself with creative strength. Molten lava pours expressively from a volcano. Fusion d'Issey Eau de Toilette transforms this eruption of energy into a bold, distinctive fragrance. This volcanic fragrance is held in a bottle replete with contrasts – tall and elegant in gleaming deep blue glass. The light shines from within, trapped and yet vibrant. The inscription "Fusion d’Issey" is written in striking orange letters, in reference to molten lava. A beautiful creation inspired by nature and redesigned by the human hand.. Fusion d’Issey Eau de Toilette is a fougère for men with solar and mineral notes. A play on contrasts between the cold and the heat of warming spices.. For the cool aspect, the sparkling brightness of lemon is paired with the milky sweetness of coconut water accord, a long-lasting solar scent. Plunging into the heart of the volcano to encounter the mineral and uncover the roundness of ambrox. Underlying the notion of "fusion" is the choice of warm, volcanic woods note.. Fragrance Notes. Top Notes: Lemon Essence, Coconut Water. Heart Notes: Sandalwood, Mineral Solar Accord. Base Notes: Patchouli Essence.

listings.rawTitle: ISSEY MIYAKE A DROP D'ISSEY EDP FRAÎCHE 90 ml
listings.description: Fresh and floral: the essence of luxuriant nature during springtime. . After a drop d’Issey Eau de Parfum, a drop d’Issey Eau de Parfum Fraîche tells a new story of water infused with blossoms. Immerse yourself in the heart of nature with a drop d'Issey Eau de Parfum Fraîche. Follow the journey of a fresh raindrop during springtime, bursting with energy and life, awakening and refreshing all the elements on its path. Feel on your skin the delicate scent of springtime with a tender, fresh floral signature. Designed by Todd Bracher, the singular bottle keeps the iconic round shape. Dreamy colors in nature tones fade from the azure blue of the sky to the vibrant green of grasses in the wind. Echoing this design, an eye-catching metallic blue-green finish adorns the new drop on the outerpack.. A drop d'Issey Eau de Parfum Fraîche is a fresh and floral fragrance for women. In the top, the rain accord created by Ane Ayo gives the fragrance its freshness. In the heart notes, lilac’s enveloping floral notes are revealed, harmonizing with damask rose to offer a fresh and delicate floral bouquet. In the base, the sandalwood, cedarwood and musky notes provide the fragrance with depth and roundness.. Fragrance Notes. Top Notes: Rain Accord. Heart Notes: Lilac, Damask Rose. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Cedar Wood, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: ISSEY MIYAKE A DROP D'ISSEY EDP 90 ml
listings.description: Joyful and radiant: a floral and solar feminine composition. . Look at the world from a new perspective with a drop d'Issey Eau de Parfum and see the hidden beauty of nature. Enlighten your mood with a wildly feminine composition: an enveloping solar bouquet of lilac with a musky note and an almond milk facet. Follow a drop in its journey through nature. In a transparent droplet, the drop loses its shape, then takes on a new one. It flattens out, then bounces back. it reflects, rebounds, and changes your perspective. The pure, round-shaped bottle combines the simplicity of a perfect, poetic shape with the deliberately tactile facet of the bottle in a single piece. Like a mirror and magnifying glass, it makes way for dreams, for poetry, and fantasy.. A drop d'Issey Eau de Parfum is a solar enveloping fragrance for women.. It reveals the scent of an uncatchable flower, the lilac, whose scent cannot be extracted from the flower in nature and was recomposed for the first time by perfumer Ane Ayo. How? By using green chemistry to make the most of highly innovative techniques while protecting actual lilacs since the flowers do not need to be harvested. It is nature, recreated by the human hand.. In the top notes, Damask rose adds a pure, sheer floral facet. In the heart of the fragrance, lilac is enhanced by a note of ethically sourced orange blossom and an almond milk accord. In the base notes, a musky accord meets upcycled cedarwood and vanillin to complete the olfactory trail.. Fragrance Notes. Top Notes: Almond Milk Accord. Heart Notes: Solar Lilac Accord. Base Notes: Musk.

listings.description: Fresh and enveloping: the purity of water with the luminous essence of Magnolia petals. . 30 years after the release of L’Eau d’Issey, Issey Miyake reinvents the way water interacts with nature. An avant-garde fragrance standing out with its rose soufflé and neo-gourmand popcorn accord. listings.rawTitle: JIMMY CHOO MAN AQUA EDT 100ml
listings.description: Renowned Perfumers, Paul Guerlain and Julien Rasquinet have come together to make an iconic splash with the new Jimmy Choo Man Aqua. This fragrance is for the man who faces life head on. The opening, is a stimulating spice and sweetness of cardamom rides a sparkling wave of grapefruit, before drying down to a fresh heart of icy geranium and clary sage, both of which mingle with the marine accord which sits at the heart of Jimmy Choo Man Aqua. At the base, patchouli and amber is afforded a soft, seafaring-inspired aspect with the addition of salted moss.. Jimmy Choo Man Aqua is like an olfactive ode to the ocean, the bottle in flask shape is instantly recognisable with a lacquering reminding of the colour of the sea. In further alignment with the broader Jimmy Choo Man fragrance family, the bottle also comes complete with an embossed crocodile-effect cap in a complimentary shade of cornflower blue. The outer packaging is adorned with the iconic Jimmy Choo Man crocodile in a dynamic ocean blue.. Fragrance Notes. Top Notes: Cardamom, Grapefruit. Heart Notes: Geranium, Clary Sage. Base Notes: Patchouli, Amber, Salted Moss.

listings.description: A lighter, fresher take on the LIBRE signature fragrance. Twisting the original blend of lavender and orange blossom with white tea. Starring Dua Lipa , Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty.. The new Eau de Toilette brings a light, fresh duality between warmth and cold to the LIBRE floral signature.. The structure of the original LIBRE composition celebrates the signature tension present in all YSL fragrances: the tension between aromatic lavender from France and sensual orange blossom absolute from Morocco. The Eau de Toilette takes this to another level in this next chapter of the Libre story, with the duality between warmth and cold. The smouldering orange blossom is infused with a colder, androgynous white tea accord, revealing a modern and bright fragrance full of sensuality.. listings.rawTitle: YVES SAINT LAURENT LIBRE EDP For Her 90 ml
listings.description: LIBRE: THE FRAGRANCE OF FREEDOM BY YVES SAINT LAURENT YSL, at the forefront of luxury beauty for over 50 years, unveils its new fragrance: LIBRE. LIBRE, the French word for ‘free’, pays tribute to YSL’s most defining and enduring value: Freedom. Freedom to be yourself. Freedom of choice. Freedom to live everything to the full. No compromise. Your own rules.. THE FACE OF FREEDOM In 2019, freedom dresses the contemporary woman: strong, bold and authentic. A woman powerful like ocean waves crashing against the shore. With fire burning in her soul, like flames flickering in the breeze. Bestowing strength and reaching high, like an eagle soaring through the sky. Embodied by uncompromising beauty, British singer song-writer Dua Lipa. “To be free for a woman in 2019 goes without asking. We live life by our own rules.” Dua Lipa, Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty.. FREEDOM, IN A SCENT Libre: a grand floral Eau de Parfum, with an unequivocal YSL twist. The burning sensuality of the orange blossom flowers from Morocco, twisted with the aromatic boldness of lavender from France. Lavender, traditionally used in male perfumery is given an ultra-feminine facet culminating in a couture-infused scent with a uniquely androgynous YSL attitude. Crafted by master perfumers Anne Flipo and Carlos Benaïm.. Fragrance Notes. Top Notes: Mandarin oil - Petit grain oil - Lavandine France oil - Blackcurrant accord. Heart Notes: Lavender oil - Jasmine Sambac absolute - Jasmine Grandiflorum India absolute - Orange flower absolute. Base Notes: Vanilla extract Madagascar - Cedarwood oil - Ambergris accord - Muscs.

listings.description: Discover the new Armani Code Eau de Parfum for men: a sensual oriental woody fragrance that conjures the mood of an intense, yet effortless, seduction. Armani Code's signature Tonka bean has been torrefied to make the scent even more intense.. The Armani Code fragrances convey a mood of elegant seduction. These sensual fragrances are inspired by the man who attracts with innate magnetism, who seduces without provocation, and who marries authenticity with an ease of being. The Armani Code Eau de Parfum is a new oriental woody fragrance that conjures the mood of an intense, yet effortless, seduction.. Each iconic facet of the Armani Code olfactory hallmarks is amplified in the new Armani Code Eau de Parfum, infusing it with a new sensuality that is at once elegant and intense. Top and middle notes, citrusy and aromatic, are found in Armani Code Eau de Parfum enriched with lemon and Lavandin to express themselves all the more fresh, incisive and colourful. A new sensoriality unfolds in the base, carnal, enveloping and mysteriously powerful thanks to the torrified Tonka bean and the addition of Vanilla, Natural Cedar and a Suede accord. Armani Code Eau de Parfum for men, a new sensuality of irresistible skin.. FRAGRANCE NOTES CITRUS TOP The fragrance opens with luminous, sparkling top notes of Mandarin and Bergamot, that are energized by an infusion of Lemon essence, the latter lending the fragrance a citrus halo.. AROMATIC HEART At the heart, notes of Rosemary and Lavender from Provence, France, exclusively crafted for Armani and sourced sustainably, combine to create a new, fascinatingly magnetic facet that has a powerfully aromatic effect.. TORREFIED TONKA BASE At the base, Armani Code’s signature Tonka bean absolute is lent a new, accentuated warmth thanks to a process of torrefaction, or roasting: the result is richer, more sensual, with an original addiction. Added to this is natural Cedar, which creates an elegant structure with its woody, dry scent, and which blends with musks for a sensual appeal. Meanwhile, natural Vanilla brings an addictive, faceted depth to the fragrance, for a sultry undertone.. . . .

listings.rawTitle: ARMANI SI PASSIONE ÉCLAT EDP 100 ml
listings.description: Passion infuses your life with meaning, it inspires you to reveal your strengths. Passion evokes a bold, modern femininity, which enables you to take on the world with grace and independence.. Giorgio Armani renews the invitation to say “Sì to passion” with Sì passione éclat de parfum, a new fragrance capturing the notion that passion lights up everyone’s life.. Sì passione éclat de parfum’s bottle allures to the gleam of a precious stone, a nod to the way passion can light up one’s life, with a fiery, ruby-red hue revealed as the bottle catches the light.. Giorgio Armani’s respect of nature favours responsibly sourced ingredients, as in this luminous fragrance belonging to the Floral Rose family. Sì passione éclat de parfum combines a bright blackcurrant accord with bergamot sustainably sourced from Calabria, Italy, and crafted for Giorgio Armani to lend another element of effervescent lightness to the scent. At the fragrance’s heart are two roses. The Centifolia rose, picked by hand in France’s Grasse region, boasts a soft, powdery quality. The Damask rose, sourced via sustainable and responsible processes, hails from Isparta, Turkey’s “city of roses”, and exhibits the generous, feminine, and characterful aspects of the flower. Finally, at the fragrance’s base white musks impart a clean, soft, and sensual quality, while the vanilla infusion from Madagascar, sourced through a sustainable and responsible program designed to support local communities, brings an enveloping effect that is at the same time addictive and spicy. Embrace this new fragrance, at once bold and radiant, and prepare to light up your life with passion. Step into your own identity without compromise and light up your life with the new Sì passione éclat de parfum.. Fragrance Notes. Top Notes: Bright Blackcurrant Accord, Bergamot. Heart Notes: Centifolia, Damask Roses. Base Notes: White Musks, Vanilla Infusion.

listings.rawTitle: JEAN PAUL GAULTIER LA MALE ELIXIR PARFUM 125 ml
listings.description: The voyage is looking torrid with Le Male Elixir, the latest recruit of the Jean Paul Gaultier crew. The flaming torso, his intense perfume for men envelopes itself with sex-appeal to the point of addiction, while the striated gold of his bulging muscles make you melt with desire. Beware of the pull of his skin made copper by the setting sun... Don’t touch! You’ll get burnt! And what of his sailor top? Its translucent brown suggests an amber wake so sensual that a single drop will make you reel.. The bottle is immediately dazzling, smouldering with virility, more flamboyant than ever. What a body, Gaultier... And what style. On his muscles cast in gold, finely sculpted striations fit the amber stripes of a very sexy sailor top which delights in playing with the see-through effects.. . WOODY AROMATIC AMBER - A very intense fragrance for a smokin’ hot skin. . On the soft skin of his torso, this intense fragrance inflames the senses leaving behind a burning sensuality. After a zesty breath of mint, its wake raises the addiction by a degree, becoming a torrid elixir. Under its fresh notes, the dashing lavender quickly takes on a carnal breadth, enhanced by the fragrant richness of benzoin with syrupy and vanilla notes. The tonka bean enriches with its hot, mellow inflections, between honey and tobacco. That’s it: you’ve been sucked in headlong!. . . . . . . . . . . . . Fragrance Notes. . Top Notes: Tonka Bean. . Heart Notes: Lavender. . Base Notes: Benzoin. . . . . . .

listings.rawTitle: YVES SAINT LAURENT BLACK OPIUM LE PARFUM 30 ml
listings.description: Black Opium, at its most luxurious. A radical quartet of sumptuous vanilla notes, ultra-dark coffee, and luminous white flowers. Smooth, sensual, and uncompromising. Experience YSL Black Opium, the rock couture fragrance for women by Yves Saint Laurent. Captivating, unparalleled in provocation, deliberatively seductive.. Starring YSL Beauty global make-up and fragrance ambassador Zoë Kravitz .. INSPIRATION . In 1977 Yves Saint Laurent introduces Opium: a boundary-pushing perfume. A revolution in a bottle. A new idea of femininity: sultry, provocative, enthralling.. Fast forward to 2014, and Opium’s legacy continues to dazzle: Yves Saint Laurent Beauty unveils Black Opium, re-inventing desire in a new, contemporary light, reshaped for the modern woman. The Black Opium woman is embodied by YSL Beauty muse Zoë Kravitz. For those seeking a luxurious, captivating fragrance that takes the signature of Black Opium to a new level of indulgence, YSL Beauty introduces Black Opium Le Parfum.. BOTTLE . Unlike any other Black Opium bottle, this over-black jewel shines from cap to toe with a reflective gloss: like an expertly cut gem, chiselled from a precious dark stone. At its centre is a dazzling heart of glitter, emblematic of the vivid fragrance found within.. THE FRAGRANCE COMPOSITION: When the electrifying energy of black coffee meets the assertive femininity of white flowers. A vibrant, sensual and addictive contrast of light and dark.. TOP NOTES: pear accord, green mandarin. HEART NOTES: orange flower petals, jasmine sambac, cinnamon essence. BASE NOTES: vanilla quartet, coffee accord, patchouli heart, ambrox. COLLECTION . YSL Beauty mixes ingredients and proportions, constantly re-interpreting Black Opium’s coffee signature. Discover the YSL Black Opium fragrance wardrobe and indulge yourself or treat others to a YSL Black Opium gift.. Black Opium Eau de Parfum. The original Eau de Parfum. Featuring adrenaline-rich black coffee and sensual vanilla. Captivating and energising. . Black Opium Eau de Parfum Illicit Green. A zesty take on the Black Opium signature. Green mandarin and creamy fig combine to create this ‘mocktail in a scent’. Energising and fresh. . Black Opium Eau de Parfum Neon. A vibrant spin on the original Black Opium Eau de Parfum. The signature coffee notes meet luminous dragon fruit. Fruity and vibrant. . Black Opium Eau de Parfum Extreme. The Black Opium signature taken to the next level. Extra-black coffee, ultra-white flowers, and an abundance of patchouli. Exhilarating and excessive. . Black Opium Eau de Parfum Intense. A bold interpretation of the Black Opium’s coffee note, enhanced by the thrilling aura of blue absinth for intensity. Deep and seductive. . .

listings.rawTitle: YSL KOUROS EDT 100 ml
listings.description: KOUROS, inspired by the gods of ancient Greece, is a men’s fragrance that embodies strength, triumphant masculinity and a conquering spirit. The resounding note of Coriander is enhanced by the energy of Bergamot and the virile power of Artemisia. The sensual Clove and floral notes of Jasmine then warm this complex and vibrant essence before Ambregris and Oakmoss complete the perfection of the trail. A divine and conquering spicy chypre fragrance with a powerful and intense trail. HOW TO USE Spray Kouros Eau de Toilette for men onto the skin, focusing on the warmest areas of your body: across bare shoulders and on the inside of bare elbows. Do not spray Kouros Eau de Toilette directly onto hair or clothing; instead, spray the fragrance in front of you and walk forwards, immersing yourself in the Kouros scent. . TOP NOTES Orange Blossom Essence Lavender Artemisia Coriander HEART NOTES Geranium Cinnamon Leaf Carnation/Clove Rosemary BASE NOTES Moss Leather Patchouli Vetiver .

listings.rawTitle: YVES SAINT LAURENT MON PARIS EDP 50ml
listings.description: REBEL HEARTS DO DECLARE "JE T'AIME" . Passionate love is essential and surrender to it's vertigo is an act of audacity. It can turn Paris upside down. And it is all real for those who dare to live it. That is how Parisian lovers feel. The original MON PARIS Eau de Parfum is a striking "Je t'aime!" declaration. The YSL Parisian femininity, both elegant and dangerous, encapsulated in a head-turning scent. The quintessential gift of love to share.. THE SCENT OF PARISIAN BLOOMING LOVE . MON PARIS is a modern astounding chypre floral. A vertiginous bouquet of daturas: a mysterious flower that only reveals its precious fragrance at nightfall, one that cannot be extracted. That is why YSL uses a patented technology to capture its olfactive snapshot and reproduce it while preserving nature. Dizzying and intoxicating, the datura is completed with aerial and elegant white peony notes; a delicious red-fruity accent; and a sensual, white patchouli essence, a special bright quality for YSL. Precious white musks finish this modern chypre signature. Hypnotic, simply irresistible. A lasting "Je t'aime!" declaration.. THE BOTTLE, THE FIRST SEDUCTION . One of the most iconic YSL fragrance bottle designs. A multi-faceted glass falcon both feminine and bold, distinctly modern. Quintessentially cool, the lavallière sits securely around the neck of the Mon Paris bottle is made from soft and matte silk, juxtaposed but two rock leather ties and a stylish shining gold YSL Cassandre. At first constrained by the neck-tie, the Mon Paris lover is overcome by a daring power of seduction, the untying of the bow symbolic of the release that comes with love. A fitting tribute to the Mon Paris woman: an elegant allure and an edgy couture style all of its own.. TOP NOTES: Pear & Fruit Be exhilarated with the exciting and vibrant juicy notes. HEART NOTES: Datura & White Flowers Feel the head-spin with the forbidden floral radiance. The signature ingredient Datura Orchid is a legendary and bewitching flower known to take on more sensuality as the night develops. BASE NOTES: Patchouli & White Musk Lose your senses with the white musk and rotating patchouli. The reminder that love is addictive however crazy and out of control. The iconic multi-faceted bottle with the cool black lavaliere and rock leather ties is a must for your dressing table - look into the Mon Paris perfume bottle and turn your world upside down. . . . . . . . . . .

listings.description: Giorgio Armani’s My Way Le Parfum is a feminine fragrance that invites you to explore new horizons. Refreshing and romantic, the scent is characterized by a powdery bouquet at its heart, perfect for springtime wear.. Top Note: Bergamot Heart Note: Tuberose Base Note: Cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The most intense and sensual interpretation of Sì’s infinite elegance.. Embrace the power of self-confidence with SÌ PARFUM, the most intense and sensual interpretation of Sì’s infinite elegance. A gourmand and leathery take on the iconic Sì chypre scent evoking a new enticing intensity. . At the core of the fragrance is an addictive vanilla, revealed in its most elegant, smoky facet. The scent opens with a gourmand blackcurrant nectar intertwined with a precious saffron accord, while at the heart is a rich rose Damascena. Vanilla becomes its most carnal at the base, as its sensual intensity is enhanced with a suede-like leathery accord and earthy patchouli.. . Discover SÌ PARFUM, a scent that captures the essence of powerful femininity and boundless possibilities.. TOP NOTE. . BLACKCURRANT NECTAR & SAFFRON ACCORD. A tantalizing whisper of fruits enhanced with a spicy saffron accord.. . HEART NOTE. . ROSE DAMASCENA. This rose extract’s floral richness and candied fruit notes evoke SÌ PARFUM’s refined and confident intensity.. . BASE NOTE. . VANILLA & LEATHER ACCORD. Sì becomes its most sensual. The gourmand facet of vanilla unfolds at the fragrance’s base, its warm intensity contrasting with an elegant leather accord.. .

Patchouli essential oil from Sumatra. . . . . . . . .

listings.rawTitle: GIORGIO ARMANI SÌ EDP 100 ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Sì Eau De Parfum – The Perfume For Women. Armani Sì is a timeless perfume that is whole-hearted and grounded yet turns into a soft trail that lingers. Sì is Italian for 'yes' and reveals the contemporary femininity of Giorgio Armani, the Sì woman has the confidence to say yes to the values that define her life. This eau de parfum resembles fresh sheets that have dried outside in the summer air, soft and warm with a hint of sophisticated sweetness. Distinctive, creamy and catches attention, Armani Sì is a floral perfume for women who are strong and graceful.. Fresh, green and addictive in its initial impression, the elegance of Freesia and the exquisite honey hues of Rose De Mai absolute make this perfume truly distinctive. The long lasting and sensual notes of Oakmoss and Patchouli softly define this fragrance as a captivating modern chypre.. Circling the neck of the Armani Si bottle is a gold ring that symbolises the promise of eternity, a perfect wedding, engagement, or anniversary gift.. Top Notes: Blackcurrant Liqueur. Heart Notes: Rose de Mai Absolute & Freesia. Base Notes: Patchouli & Oakmoss. .

listings.description: Discover STRONGER WITH YOU AMBER, the fougère ambery fragrance blending a deeply sensual amber accord with Lavender, sustainably sourced in Provence, and Vanilla, sustainably sourced in Madagascar. Crafted for both men and women, STRONGER WITH YOU AMBER is an addictive, radiant and warm interpretation of the Stronger with You signature fragrance.. STRONGER WITH YOU AMBER is captured in the distinctive Emporio Armani You fragrance glass bottle. Crafted in a translucent ambery shade and adorned with a design of interlacing gold rings, this new luxurious bottle is inspired by the ever-radiant amber stone.. TOP NOTE. . LAVENDER. Sustainably sourced from Provence, Lavender brings a freshness to the scent adding a powerfully floral and clean facet. . . . . HEART NOTE. AMBER. At the heart, the Amber accord lends a warm, carnal flamboyance to the fragrance. . . . . . BASE NOTE. VANILLA. An addictive vanilla bourbon, sustainably sourced in Madagascar underlining the fragrance’s unmistakably sensual qualities. . . . . .

listings.rawTitle: ACQUA DI GIÒ PROFONDO EAU DE TOILETTE 50 ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani unveils ACQUA DI GIÒ PROFONDO EAU DE TOILETTE, a fragrance with a new fresh intensity, capturing the thrill of plunging into the coolness of the ocean. A contrast of sparkling spices and zesty grapefruit, energized by the crispness of cypress and the herbaceous depth of lavandin. Emblematic of ACQUA DI GIÒ PROFONDO EAU DE TOILETTE’s invigorating appeal, the signature Acqua Di Giò flacon is dressed in graduated, frosted blue tones, nodding to the nuanced shades of the deepest seas. . . TOP NOTE LEMON ESSENCE & FRESH SPICES. This plunge into the sea begins with the sharpness of lemon essence, which unfolds into a sparkling blend of fresh spices. Infusing these top notes with a luminous, fruity quality is grapefruit essence, in which the colorful facets evoke an elemental contrast. . . . . . HEART NOTE LAVENDIN ESSENCE & AQUATIC ACCORD. The depths of the ocean emerge in the heart of the fragrance, as cypress essence, with its spicy, resinous, and camphor notes, intertwines with the herbaceous, aromatic lavandin essence. Uniting the heart notes is the powerful aquatic freshness of Calone, the marine accord that is the signature of all the ACQUA DI GIÒ fragrances. . . . . . BASE NOTE PATCHOULI & WOODY MINERAL ACCORD. And to evoke the bold strength of the sea, patchouli from Guatemala lends a woody earthiness to the fragrance, fusing with the salty sensuality of a woody mineral accord, conjuring the sheer power of the elements. . . . . . . .
